name: Rigid heddle loom
definition: Portable loom with a rigid heddle that works as a two-shaft loom, made for plain weave and simple patterns.

name: Floor loom
definition: Large multi-shaft loom on a floor frame, treadled, made for complex and large weaving.

name: Table loom
definition: Multi-shaft loom that sits on a table, made for patterned weaving in less space than a floor loom.

name: Inkle loom
definition: Compact loom made for weaving narrow bands such as belts and straps.

name: Tapestry loom
definition: Frame loom with even warp tension made for tapestry and wall hangings.

name: Alcohol art marker
definition: Alcohol-ink blending marker, often twin-tipped, made for illustration and colouring.

name: Paint marker
definition: Opaque paint-ink marker or pen that writes on canvas, wood, glass, metal and most surfaces.

name: Brush pen
definition: Marker or pen with a flexible brush nib made for lettering, line variation and watercolour effects.

name: Soft pastel
definition: Stick of pigment and little binder, made for drawing and painting.

name: Oil pastel
definition: Stick of pigment in an oil and wax binder, made for drawing and painting.

name: Gesso and primer
definition: Liquid ground, usually acrylic gesso, laid on a surface before painting.
